old_problem: Items says ChassisCollection while the explicit Procedure queries `/redfish/v1/Systems`; DeepSeek further substitutes IPMI. Prior review requested an owner choice. DMTF, however, defines `/Systems` as ComputerSystemCollection and `/Chassis` as ChassisCollection, while the next source row separately owns a `/Systems/{id}` member.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict using DMTF Redfish semantics and source-specific precedence. The unambiguous executable Procedure owns a GET of `/redfish/v1/Systems`, so this review validates a ComputerSystemCollection; the Items label remains historical but cannot change the resource type. Row 1961 retains independent member coverage. A secure certificate-validating GET, complete collection/member traversal and schema/value oracles replace both unsafe curl syntax and IPMI substitution. Exact member set/values are fail-closed Project Configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1960, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, adjacent row 1961 and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next formal row was directly opened as Functionality 1961 / Wistron-BMC-00997-V002 / 82f84ceb8d678697.
DMTF DSP0268 identifies `/redfish/v1/Systems` as ComputerSystemCollection and `/redfish/v1/Chassis` as ChassisCollection; the resource type is not a project guess.
Procedure URI is concrete and row 1961 continues with `/Systems/system`, supporting collection-then-member coverage. Renaming the execution target does not delete the original Items label.
IPMI chassis status cannot prove Redfish authentication, TLS, HTTP status, OData resource identity, JSON schema, Members or semantic values.
Credentials in URL and `curl -k` are rejected. Secret injection, verified TLS and redacted evidence are mandatory.
No Redfish, curl, IPMI, authentication, session, network, BMC or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Redfish ComputerSystemCollection `/redfish/v1/Systems` schema, members and value validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact BMC's authenticated Redfish ComputerSystemCollection is reachable over trusted TLS, schema-valid, contains exactly the approved system members and exposes correct collection/member inventory without errors.
required_package: Exact BMC/firmware/Redfish service identity, discovered Systems link and matching DMTF/OEM schema bundle/profile
Versioned expected member count/URIs and required ComputerSystem field/value matrix for this platform
Certificate-validating Redfish client with bounded timeouts, structured JSON/OData validation and protected least-privilege secret/session handling
Evidence redaction/hash policy and approved management endpoint/account scope
Independent row-1961 member coverage mapping and BMC support/recovery contact
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; discover the service root's Systems link, require it to identify the approved `/redfish/v1/Systems` ComputerSystemCollection, then issue authenticated GETs using verified TLS and protected secrets. Preserve redacted HTTP status/headers and complete JSON hashes, validate `@odata.id`, `@odata.type`, `Members@odata.count`, member uniqueness/URIs and matching schema, traverse every expected member read-only and compare approved inventory fields. Do not use URL credentials, `-k`, IPMI substitution, POST/PATCH/DELETE, insecure retry or secret-bearing evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The verified endpoint returns 2xx, valid JSON and the approved ComputerSystemCollection OData/schema identity; count equals unique Members, every expected URI is present and readable, no unapproved member/error occurs, and required collection/member values match the exact firmware/platform contract.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires trusted target/TLS/authentication, correct ComputerSystemCollection identity, valid complete JSON/schema, exact member set/count, successful bounded traversal and all required semantic values. FAIL on TLS/auth/HTTP/JSON/schema/resource-type/member/value error or secret leakage. NOT READY applies when trust, credential, schema/profile or oracle is absent. IPMI output or HTTP 200 alone cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Only bounded GET requests; prohibit actions and POST/PATCH/DELETE.
Use verified TLS and protected secrets; never URL credentials, command-line passwords or `-k`.
Redact secrets while preserving diagnostic status, resource identities and hashed payloads; stop on leakage or unexpected redirect.
Do not retry insecurely or clear BMC logs; close/revoke session according to policy.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and retained legacy label, BMC/firmware/Redfish/schema/client/TLS/account-scope identity
Redacted request metadata, HTTP status and complete collection JSON hash
OData/resource-type/schema validation, member count/URI uniqueness and expected-set comparison
Read-only member traversal and field/value results tied to row-1961 boundary
test_case.recovery: On TLS, authentication, redirect, schema, payload or evidence failure, stop and close/revoke the session; rotate any exposed secret and preserve redacted audit data. Use the approved BMC support path and do not retry with `-k`, URL credentials, IPMI or write methods.

source_conflict.reason: DMTF defines `/Systems` as ComputerSystemCollection; the explicit Procedure governs execution while the imprecise Items label is retained only for traceability, and IPMI is rejected.
